svg.text: Cut one 213.5 mm length of 25 x 25 x 2 tube; square the end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: that meets the post carefully (it sets the arm level); deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: This length suits a phone whose lens is on its centre line across the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: width. If yours is d mm off that line, lay the phone with the lens

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the side away from the post and cut the arm d mm shorter.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side holes, across the side faces, 12.5 mm down from the top:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 5.5 mm holes 22.5 and 62.5 mm from the post end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top-to-bottom holes, on the centre line of the top face:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 5.5 mm holes 16 and 46 mm from the free end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: square end against the post's front face, top faces level;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corner plates on both sides; the tray tab under the free end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both ends square; side holes match the corner plate holes.
